notes.title: Celebration Stream for BAFL release on Switch, big sale & patch for PC users!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29142966/2d78d17d98643ea68a4a2618043382e27e93e0f4.png[/img]
Hi pilots!

To celebrate [b]BAFL release[/b] on [b]Nintendo Switch[/b], we're doing a special [b]stream[/b] on [b]Twitch[/b], [b]Youtube[/b] & [b]Facebook[/b]! Alain, our beloved [b]developer[/b] of the game & Mickael, Playdius' [b]community manager[/b] will introduce you the [b]main modes[/b] in the game!

Then, it will be time to get on the starting line, they'll [b]compete[/b] in a [b]championship[/b] to see who's the better [b]pilot[/b]! (Spoiler: one has many more hours on the game :p)

Maybe some [b]free play[/b] with more players after that!

The stream is scheduled for [b]6PM GMT+1[/b], find us on:
[b]Twitch[/b]: https://www.twitch.tv/playdiusgames
[b]Youtube[/b]: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCMRoOwD0UfPzNqCevbkKfaQ
[b]Facebook[/b]: https://www.facebook.com/PlaydiusGames/

Because good news never come alone, the [b]game on PC will be 40% off[/b] during [b]one week[/b]! We've also done a [b]patch[/b], mainly to add [b]optimizations[/b] made for the Switch to the [b]PC version[/b]!

Patch log:
- optimization: various performance optimizations (including new light system at night)
- optimization: greatly reduced application loading time
- hints: new cinematics the first time in the menu track, to show the different parts of the game
- hints: new "double tap" tutorial to pop before harder races, unless you've already used it often enough
- fixes: AI cars could trigger the perfect lap achievement (oops)
- For Razer lovers: Razer Chroma keyboard support (lots of flashing lights!)

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29142966/e7215e0f79f16ca8d29ea39e482c9831cbdc922d.png[/img]
Hope you'll [b]join us[/b] on the [b]stream[/b], don't hesitate to [b]ask questions[/b] in the [b]chats[/b], we'll try our best to [b]answer[/b] them while we showcase the game!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 is live!
notes.notes:
[b]What’s new[/b]

BAFL has been out for a month now, it’s time to update to version 1.0.1!

We’ve added or changed some features and did some balancing, here’s the full list:

- in Time Attack you can now race against the dev's ghost!
- the quick-turn hint is now shown in the how-to screen
- in quick race mode, in-between rankings now show a general ranking instead of the last race's rankings
- money bonus now appears more often
- Vegas track: short cut through the grass slows you down a little less (it's now worth it in time attack!)

And this update also solves a few bugs! (see patch log at the end).

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29142966/b65c96b07a4ff917ef129bef996bb9d1d9dd6828.png[/img]


[b]What’s coming[/b]

It’s time to announce some of the next steps to go for BAFL’s development!

For now, the next milestone is to port the game on Mac, we hope to make it available as soon as possible!

We’re also working on porting the game on consoles. The console versions will add new content to the game: extra cars, extra tracks… If you have any wishes or suggestions, now is a good time to speak.

And note that, once ready for consoles, this will come as a free update for PC users too!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29142966/3fa23fa1ce1b811959060b6969d8fee44d9c8bdd.jpg[/img]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Thanks to your feedbacks, we’ve identified various bugs that we’ve worked on fixing, here are the main issues that are corrected in this patch: 


- bug fix: fixed the bug where a car could remain wrecked if it exploded while being thrown out of the pits
- bug fix: the "win all races" achievements now work properly
- bug fix: night can now happen in quick race mode
- bug fix: pixelization could remain active at the end of the race. It shouldn't any more (hard to reproduce)
- various graphics & interface fixes

notes.title: Warm-up Lap #3 - Second Update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29142966/8372a60f77c5916b458852d965a16e812df9cca0.png[/img]

Lap #3 - In space, no one can hear you brake! Deal with portals to teleport ahead & be careful with the crossroad!

[b]What's new:[/b]
[list]
[*]New track: Space Station! A relatively easy track with a crossroad and a portal! You'll find it early in the championship and in the first screen of the challenges.
[*]Better lights for Ice track by night
[*]Pixelisation pick-up: the area around the car which picked it up is not affected anymore
[*]Support for chinese/japanese/korean and cyrillic characters
[*]Various bug fixes
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29142966/d91c8e7d5cd23c26af9c2f12b7d4dfab11bc6b9c.jpg[/img]

Talk to you next week!

notes.title: Warm-up Lap #2 - First Update!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29142966/8372a60f77c5916b458852d965a16e812df9cca0.png[/img]
Lap #2 - Fresh new track: Winter is braking! You'll have to slide your way through an icy road while your Adhesion stat is ignored. Stay frosty & manage your drifts to master this race circuit!

What's new:
- New "Ice" track! Challenges for this track can be found in the hard part (the third part to the left) of the main menu (you'll have to unlock it first!)
- New explosion animation
- Skid marks now take the color of certain elements you pass through (e.g. oil, grass, ice)

Fixes:
- Fixed: in Time Attack, before the race starts, the ghost car sometimes appeared ahead of the start line
- Fixed: left-hand keyboard controls now can be used in menus
- Fixed: cars can no longer get stuck in the borders of the track (hopefully :P)
- Fixed: various UI issues
- Fixed: leaderboard used to freeze if there were no entries
- Fixed: in Perfect Race, boosts are no longer displayed above the car. You can still use them as much as you want, though it's not recommended if you don't want to hit the track. ;)

Known issues:
- Sometimes when playing a Time Attack, the car just stops. We're still hunting that one down. If you encounter it, please report it with as much detail as you can.
- Car choosing screen/shop is broken when playing on a 4:3 screen (but who does? :P)

Stay tuned for more updates, and see you on the tracks.
